chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'May Allah have mercy upon the parents who support their children in their righteousness.'
ai.seo_question: What is the virtue of parents who help their children in righteousness?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) underscores the reciprocal nature of filial piety, noting that divine mercy is specifically promised to parents who actively facilitate their children's obedience to them. This highlights the scholarly view that parental authority is not merely about command but involves nurturing the child's capacity for 'birr' (righteousness), thereby transforming the parent-child relationship into a shared spiritual endeavor. It serves as a practical guideline for families, suggesting that active support in religious and moral duties is a key mechanism for securing Allah's rahma.
